content: Remember how brief is the span of a mortal life, and how great the abyss of the infinite past and future.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Marcus Aurelius understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
